title: Qman DirectPath complete trust key-ring history descriptor
description: A closed descriptor for every signed key-ring revision from genesis through the current ring. A current ring plus an unresolved previousKeyRingDigest is not sufficient trust evidence.

rings.x-qmanCanonicalOrder: strictly ascending keyRingSequence with no gaps, beginning at 1

x-qmanChainRule: Resolve every descriptor path inside the evidence repository; verify byte hash, exact schema hash, complete closed-schema instance, canonical keyRingDigest and root quorum signatures. There are exactly currentKeyRingSequence descriptors numbered 1..current with no duplicate or skipped sequence. Sequence 1 has previousKeyRingDigest=null; every successor previousKeyRingDigest byte-equals the predecessor keyRingDigest; all rings use keyRingId; final digest/sequence equal the top-level current values.
x-qmanIdentityContinuityRule: Across the complete chain, an existing keyId or Ed25519 public key never changes principalId. Revocation is monotonic. A removed/revoked key cannot silently reappear, validity cannot be extended in place, and rotation creates a new keyId. Every revision is independently rooted; history does not make an invalid signature valid.
x-qmanDigestRule: Set historyDigest to null in an in-memory projection and hash the complete CANONICAL-JSON-V1 object. The null calculation form need not satisfy the stored schema.
